fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: A cut on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Hooves Over Furrows
fusions.desc: Sweeps a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocks each back 3 tiles and leaves it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Headland Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Draft Beast in Harness
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking an enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.8 seconds. You can ride it. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
